items.title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
items.summary: Pretrained LeWorldModel's reproduction of small action effects is evaluated via Gram matrices across perturbation scales, showing scale-dependent sensitivity differences and higher errors than environment references.

items.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
items.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

items.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
items.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark and training dataset to evaluate multimodal language models as judges of physically valid, instruction-aligned embodied video generation, yielding a fine-tuned 9B judge with high human agreement.

items.title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
items.summary: SlideBench benchmarks continuous image editing and SliderEdit++ improves slider reliability via trajectory regularization and disentanglement for smoother, faster control.

items.title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary: MMVistaReason improves open multimodal reasoning through structured data construction, difficulty-aware distillation, and specialized reinforcement learning integration.

items.title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
items.summary: CoRE jointly learns reasoning rules and constrained evidence retrieval through alternating reinforcement and contrastive learning without predefined query-rule supervision.

items.title: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
items.summary: DISC is a learnable framework that calibrates and combines time-series dataset similarity metrics to better predict downstream forecasting transfer performance.

items.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary: A pipeline using sparse autoencoders extracts interpretable linguistic features from neural detectors, yielding more accurate and explainable AI-generated text classification.

items.title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
items.summary: TenetBench evaluates whether language models adhere to professional ethical codes by pairing conflicting requests with benign equivalents, revealing frequent unflagged violations across most tested models.

items.title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
items.summary: DuoLM accelerates personalized recommendation by combining a compact encoder and ranker with optimized inference, achieving high throughput with minimal quality loss.

items.title: A path-following framework on fiber bundle for variational inequalities
items.summary: A path-following framework on a fixed-point fiber bundle achieves global linear convergence for variational inequalities with continuous mappings over polytopes without monotonicity assumptions.

items.title: The fixed-point bundle method over product-of-simplex domains arising from game equilibria
items.summary: A fixed-point bundle framework extended to product-of-simplex domains via geometric equivalence yields globally convergent path-following algorithms for Nash equilibrium computation.

items.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
items.summary: Foundation models can self-improve across text and vision tasks by generating synthetic questions and reasoning traces guided only by high-level topics, without external supervision.

items.title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: MultiAgent-OPD jointly trains a hierarchical multi-agent team via on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning, using a frozen teacher for local process supervision to improve end-to-end performance across multiple datasets.

items.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
items.summary: LoCA is a two-stage pipeline that trains co-aligned multimodal image encoders and uses them as high-rank targets to train location and metadata encoders via contrastive learning, outperforming existing methods across diverse geospatial tasks.

items.title: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
items.summary: DraMaze improves long-form microdrama script generation by using evolutionary tree search guided by trope memory and backward narrative dependency trees to enhance plot diversity and coherence.

items.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
items.summary: TWIG represents neural network weights as shared discrete decision paths, unifying compression methods and enabling efficient fixed-weight circuits with optimized discrete choices.

items.title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
items.summary: Dual Exam evaluates multimodal agents and world models separately across diverse domains, revealing uneven performance and no coupled success in pilot tests.

items.title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.summary: HiSTEVE is a hierarchical vision-language-action agent that combines long-horizon planning with native keyboard-and-mouse control to perform complex open-ended tasks in Minecraft.

items.title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
items.summary: Flow matching is investigated for four-source full-band stereo music separation, evaluating prediction targets, flow paths, modeling strategies, and consistency constraints with both signal-level and perceptual metrics.

items.title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
items.summary: Easy-3Dfy separates object generation from scene layout estimation and uses geometric alignment to combine high-quality 3D objects with spatial understanding for improved scene reconstruction.

items.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
items.summary: RSIHub is an open-source framework that standardizes agent-evolution research by providing shared infrastructure for building, comparing, and extending methods with reusable components and consistent evaluation.

items.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
items.summary: RynnUnify is a 16B unified embodied model that integrates visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control, achieving state-of-the-art results on long-horizon embodied tasks.

items.title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
items.summary: Echo integrates stop and failure signals into a vision-language-action model to guide robot execution and recovery without fine-grained progress labels.

items.title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
items.summary: Generalized CycleGRPO unifies region understanding and localization via reinforcement learning with self-verified cycle consistency across images and videos, improving grounding and temporal distinctiveness without external judges.

items.title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
items.summary: UserArena introduces a real-world interactive benchmark with long-horizon shopping trajectories and an evaluation framework, alongside On-Policy Trajectory Distillation to improve simulator fidelity for agentic recommendations.

items.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
items.summary: DirCast is a streaming video language model that simultaneously directs live esports broadcasts by selecting cameras and generates real-time commentary using only past context.

items.title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
items.summary: HoloBoxing learns humanoid boxing by combining a frozen whole-body controller with a compact planner that predicts body-point targets, using imitation initialization and reinforcement learning to refine interaction behavior with minimal additional training.

items.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
items.summary: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free framework that reduces cross-modal hallucinations in omni LLMs by identifying modality conflicts and rebalancing hidden representations to suppress misleading priors.

items.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
items.summary: TARSphere is a robot framework that integrates physics simulation, embodied NPCs, and a frozen multimodal language model to evaluate long-horizon embodied agents across diverse indoor tasks and social conditions.

items.title: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
items.summary: LLM-Attacker standardizes privacy evaluations for split language models by recording attacker configurations, enabling comparable scoring of reconstruction attacks, and requiring linked undefended baselines for defense claims.

items.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
items.summary: AI agents can automate benchmark design to reduce evaluation costs, but their generated evaluators still fall short of target agreement and suffer from budget exhaustion and score dominance issues.

items.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
items.summary: Diffusion language models spend more computation on novel, rare, or incorrect outputs, and decoding speed can improve inference efficiency and reliability.

items.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: T2Quant improves diffusion language model quantization by dynamically allocating activation precision across denoising steps based on predicted task- and time-dependent sensitivity.

items.title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
items.summary: ID-TAP uses a neural dueling-bandit framework with similarity-weighted warm starts to adapt LLM agents to user preferences via binary response comparisons within a limited interaction budget.

items.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: IF-MAP identifies high-impact agents in multi-agent LLM systems via prompt perturbation analysis to maximize system-level gains from targeted improvements.

items.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
items.summary: LLM agents frequently leak sensitive conclusions assembled from multiple confidential documents, and common safeguards fail to eliminate this mosaic-style disclosure risk.

items.title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
items.summary: HyperDrone is a GPU-accelerated quadrotor simulator using a ray-tracing engine to render high-fidelity observations at high speed, enabling vision-based policy training and real-world transfer.

items.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
items.summary: BrickWright improves physical validity of AI-generated LEGO assemblies by providing agents with an assembly API and feasibility validator, achieving perfect validity while preserving prompt adherence.

items.title: Who Takes the Lead? Model Ability and Task-Conditioned Collaboration with Humans
items.summary: Researchers use a shared-control maze to show that stronger language-model agents selectively involve humans based on route advantage rather than failing to collaborate.

items.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
items.summary: FilmFlow is an agentic framework that translates natural-language or video instructions into executable camera trajectories for 3D scenes using specialized director, interpreter, scout, and critic agents, evaluated on the CinemaBench dataset.

items.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
items.summary: RIDAR detects and mitigates research integrity violations in autonomous agents via taxonomy-based post-hoc analysis and real-time intervention.

items.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
items.summary: Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.

items.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.

items.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
items.summary: SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.

items.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
items.summary: RTAformer separately models persistent entities and changing relations in video scene graphs by injecting calibrated query differences and aligning cross-frame instances to overcome relational semantic inertia.

items.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: IQuest-Q1 is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model trained via multi-stage pre-training, mid-training, and post-training to achieve strong agentic coding and general capabilities.

items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: WeVisOne-VL unifies object-level and pixel-level visual perception via structured token prediction, supporting detection, localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting with a lightweight pixel decoder and multi-stage training.

items.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: GAFU leverages native generation-side representations to improve fine-grained visual understanding in unified multimodal models by compressing them into compact tokens for task-conditioned retrieval.

items.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.
